decisions.rationale: Leading Staraptor and Farigiraf neutralizes Fake Out and priority moves via Armor Tail while deploying Intimidate on entry. Staraptor-Mega provides offensive pressure with Contrary Close Combat and Dual Wingbeat (which threatens Sneasler), while Farigiraf offers Psychic pressure and Trick Room setup. Kingambit and Arcanine-Hisui in the back provide heavy offensive cleanup, with Kingambit's Defiant directly punishing Incineroar's Intimidate or Parting Shot.
decisions.notebook: Opponent revealed sets: Delphox-Mega (Timid, Delphoxite: Protect, Heat Wave, Psyshock, Nasty Plot), Incineroar (Impish, Sitrus Berry, Intimidate: Flare Blitz, Throat Chop, Parting Shot, Fake Out), Sneasler (Jolly, Focus Sash, Poison Touch: Close Combat, Poison Jab, Quick Guard, Fake Out). Flex slots: Blastoise, Kingambit, Sinistcha. Strategy: Block priority with Armor Tail; pair Trick Room with Kingambit to counter high-speed leads like Delphox and Sneasler.

decisions.rationale: Repeat the game-1 winning formula: lead Incineroar + Sneasler for Intimidate, Fake Out pressure and immediate CC/Flare Blitz trades (e.g., into Mega Raichu), with Mega Delphox and Kingambit in back — both immune to Farigiraf's only attack, Delphox's Psyshock answers Staraptor once chipped, Heat Wave + Flare Blitz chip beats their Kingambit, and Kingambit resists Sylveon's Pixilate Hyper Voice while hitting back super effectively. This covers every opposing mode; their Trick Room only accelerates my slow backline.
decisions.notebook: Opponent VR Aug top-8 list; ONE Mega per game. Up 1-0; game-1 bring (Incineroar+Sneasler lead, Mega Delphox + Kingambit back) worked, they Mega'd Raichu and benched Sylveon + Arcanine-H — expect adaptation. Durable facts: Farigiraf is their TR setter with Armor Tail (nullifies ALL my priority into their side) and its ONLY attack is Psychic — Incineroar and Kingambit are immune, Mega Delphox takes ~17%; it can never beat my core alone and will Protect-stall TR turns. Staraptor is their only real sweeper: non-Mega Jolly CC takes ~50% off Impish Incineroar; Delphox Psyshock KOs it even at -2 once chipped; keep my Kingambit far from CC (4x weak). If they Mega Staraptor, Contrary turns CC drops into Def/SpD boosts — kill Farigiraf first, finish with Sucker Punch not Psyshock. Their Kingambit falls to Flare Blitz chip + Heat Wave even with Delphox at -1/-2; never Psyshock into a possible Kingambit switch (Dark immune). Raichu Mega-Y No Guard Zap Cannon auto-paralyzes but Focus Sash Sneasler CC + Incineroar Flare Blitz trades it turn 1. Vs Sylveon (Pixilate Hyper Voice under TR): Kingambit resists and Kowtow Cleaves SE, keep Sneasler away (4x weak). Vs Arcanine-H (Focus Sash): Kingambit resists Head Smash, Delphox Heat Wave only 0.25x — use Incineroar/Sneasler CC. Don't fear their Trick Room; it speeds up my slow attackers.

decisions.rationale: Armor Tail prevents Fake Out from both foes. Sneasler lacks Protect, so combining Dual Wingbeat (Mega Evolving Staraptor to activate Contrary and gain stat boosts) with Farigiraf's 4x super-effective Psychic guarantees a KO on Sneasler through its Focus Sash on Turn 1.

decisions.rationale: Confirmed ranges: Sneasler is in mortal danger this turn — Staraptor's Dual Wingbeat alone (69-102%, two hits) KOs it through Focus Sash, and Farigiraf's Psychic is a guaranteed OHKO; my Fake Outs are dead into Armor Tail and Sneasler's CC only does 35-68% to Staraptor anyway, so Sneasler has no productive stay-in play. Hard-switching Sneasler to Kingambit (resolves before moves) makes slot b immune to Psychic and barely scratched by Wingbeat, preserving Sneasler+sash as my anti-Sylveon/Raichu piece; the only punish is a hard-predicted Mega Close Combat into slot b. Incineroar is safe tanking CC (30-44%, Sitrus) since Farigiraf can't touch it, so it stays and Throat Chops Farigiraf for 29-56% chip, which puts Farigiraf into guaranteed KO range for Kingambit's Life Orb Kowtow Cleave next turn — under Trick Room my 71-Speed Kingambit moves before their Farigiraf, so TR actually enables the kill on their setter.

If they Mega Staraptor (Contrary, Fighting/Flying): Kowtow/Sucker only 0.5x, CC drops become Def boosts — answer it with Delphox Psyshock (2x, targets Def) or Sneasler Poison Jab (2x), keep Kingambit away from CC (4x weak; Mega CC at -1 is a KO range on switch-in). Their Kingambit: Flare Blitz chip + Heat Wave kills, never Psyshock into it. Vs Sylveon: Kingambit resists + Kowtow SE. Vs Arcanine-H (Sash): Kingambit resists Head Smash, use CC/Flare Blitz not Heat Wave (0.25x). Raichu Mega-Y: No Guard Zap Cannon auto-para; Delphox outspeeds + Psyshock KOs its 55 Def.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks priority moves like Sucker Punch while Helping Hand boosts Mega Staraptor's Close Combat into a guaranteed KO on Kingambit before Kingambit can move (Staraptor Speed 178 vs Kingambit 70-102). Contrary also grants Staraptor +1 Defense and +1 Special Defense from Close Combat.

decisions.rationale: Staraptor-Mega is Contrary: its CC is a guaranteed KO on Kingambit (98.6-144.9%), so Kingambit can't stay in, and Parting Shot/re-Intimidate would only boost it. But Delphox hard-walls Staraptor — CC is 0.5x resisted (26-36%), Psychic resisted too, so even a doubled hit can't KO it on the switch. Kingambit pivots out at 90% preserved for their backline while Delphox becomes the Staraptor answer: Mega Delphox is 204 Spe/179 SpA, always outspeeds Staraptor (143-178), and two Psyshocks kill through any Contrary Def boosts. With Kingambit's Kowtow threat off the field Farigiraf won't Protect, so Incineroar's Throat Chop connects (~1/3 KO now, Sitrus otherwise, second chop finishes) to remove the Trick Room/Armor Tail linchpin before it can grind. Next turn: Mega Delphox Psyshock + second chop.
decisions.notebook: Opponent VR Aug top-8 list; ONE Mega per game. Up 1-0. G1: they Mega'd Raichu, benched Sylveon + Arcanine-H. G2: they lead Staraptor + Farigiraf (Tailwind/TR speed-control mode). KEY CORRECTIONS: (1) Staraptor-Mega = Contrary Fighting/Flying, 140 Atk/100 Def/110 Spe — NEVER Parting Shot or Intimidate it (flips to boosts); every CC it uses grants +1 Def/+1 SpD, kill it fast. Its CC: guaranteed KO on my Kingambit (4x), 50-72% on Incineroar, but only 26-36% vs Delphox (0.5x) — Delphox is the hard counter. (2) My Delphox = 32 Spe points: 171 base, Mega = 204 Spe/179 SpA, always outspeeds Staraptor-Mega; Mega Psyshock ~71-125% at +0 Def, 2HKO guaranteed through Def boosts. Delphox immune to their Kingambit's Dark moves; use Heat Wave (never Psyshock) vs their Kingambit. (3) Sneasler Poison Jab vs Staraptor is only 1x (old note wrong) — Sneasler strictly for Sylveon (Jab 2x)/Raichu (CC) duty; never vs Staraptor (Dual Wingbeat KOs through Sash) or Farigiraf (Psychic OHKO). Durable: Farigiraf = TR setter, Sitrus Berry, Armor Tail blocks all my priority into their side while alive, only attack Psychic (my Incineroar/Kingambit immune, Delphox resists); Kingambit Kowtow = guaranteed KO on it from 54%+; two Incineroar Throat Chops kill through Sitrus; under TR my Kingambit (71) out-slows their whole side. Vs Arcanine-H: Head Smash is 2x vs Delphox — respect it; Kingambit resists Head Smash, use CC/Flare Blitz not Heat Wave (0.25x). Raichu Mega-Y: No Guard Zap Cannon auto-para; Delphox outspeeds + Psyshock KOs its 55 Def. G2 plan: Delphox pivots into Staraptor (safe), Megas, Psyshocks twice; Incineroar double-chop kills Farigiraf; preserved Kingambit + Sneasler clean the backline.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf uses Protect to absorb expected single-target Dark/Fire attacks from Incineroar and preserve Armor Tail on the field. Staraptor-Mega uses Close Combat into Incineroar to deal heavy super-effective damage (48.5-88.2%) while boosting its own Defense and Special Defense to +2 via Contrary, making it extraordinarily resilient to incoming attacks.

Arcanine-Hisui is the ideal replacement here: holding Focus Sash guarantees it survives any single attack from Delphox-Mega or Incineroar, and its Head Smash guarantees a KO on Delphox-Mega (55% HP). Additionally, Farigiraf's Armor Tail prevents Fake Out from breaking Arcanine's Focus Sash.

CORRECTION: Delphox is WEAK to Dark (2x), not immune — their Kingambit's Kowtow/Sucker threaten Delphox; answer with Sneasler CC (4x SE) or Mega Delphox Heat Wave (2x), never Psyshock (Dark immune). Raichu (Mega-Y No Guard Zap Cannon auto-para in G1 form): Delphox outspeeds, Psyshock KOs its 55 Def. Sneasler duty: Sylveon (Jab 2x) / Raichu (CC); never vs Staraptor (DW KOs through Sash) or Farigiraf (Psychic OHKO). G2 plan: chop Farigiraf dead, Mega Delphox Psyshocks Staraptor 2-3x tanking resisted CCs; Kingambit + Sneasler clean the backline. If G3: expect Raichu or Kingambit adjustments; Delphox anchors vs Staraptor, Sneasler vs Sylveon/Kingambit, preserve Incineroar Intimidate for physical backs.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Arcanine-Hisui)
decisions.rationale: Delphox-Mega is faster than Arcanine-Hisui and poses a high threat, but Arcanine-Hisui at 100% HP with Focus Sash guarantees surviving any single attack and cleanly KOes Delphox-Mega with Head Smash (125.3-241.3% damage range). Meanwhile, Armor Tail suppresses priority moves like Fake Out. Setting Trick Room with Farigiraf provides a huge late-game advantage for our Kingambit if Farigiraf survives the turn.

Arcanine-H outspeeds and its Head Smash is a guaranteed KO on 56% Delphox and ~60% on Incineroar before Incineroar (88 Spe) can even move, while no KO is available on Arcanine (Focus Sash) or a guaranteed one on Farigiraf. So I pivot safely: Incineroar switches to Kingambit, which hard-walls Arcanine (Head Smash only 15.9-34.3%) and, like Incineroar, is immune to Farigiraf's Psychic; Delphox Protects to guarantee survival. This preserves all four of my Pokemon, and any Trick Room only benefits my slow Kingambit. Next turn I can switch Delphox back to Incineroar for a re-Intimidate while Kingambit grinds Arcanine with Kowtow Cleave (40.6-89.4%, 2HKO through Sash), saving Delphox/Sneasler for their backline.

reflections.summary: Won the series 2-0; game 2 closed in 9 turns with zero decision errors. The preview plan matched their shell exactly: Mega Delphox removed Mega Staraptor with Psyshock on turn 3 before Contrary boosts could snowball, Kingambit was immune to Farigiraf's Psychic and walled Arcanine-H, and Sneasler's 4x-SE Close Combat deleted their Kingambit the turn Trick Room expired, then cleaned up Farigiraf. Their one strong sequence — Farigiraf Protecting under pressure, then clicking Trick Room — gave Arcanine-H/Kingambit real mid-game pressure (Incineroar survived Head Smash only thanks to Sitrus), but Incineroar's Intimidate plus Parting Shot chip blunted their physical attackers until TR ended. Every between-game adjustment helped and none backfired: Delphox-Mega as the dedicated Staraptor answer, Sneasler preserved for their Kingambit, no Sucker Punch/Fake Out into Armor Tail, and no Intimidate into post-Mega Contrary Staraptor or Defiant Kingambit.
reflections.adjustment: Plan explicitly for their Protect-into-Trick-Room sequencing: either double into Farigiraf before TR goes up (it Protects on obvious pressure turns, so attack the partner slot or call the Protect), or accept TR and pilot around it — keep my own 71-Spe Kingambit healthy as a TR abuser and hold Sneasler in back, since it outspeeds their entire roster once TR ends. Remove Staraptor immediately: at +1 Def from Contrary Close Combat the Psyshock OHKO needed a crit, so strike before boosts accumulate or add chip first. Avoid leaning on the Kingambit speed-tie mirror under TR; Sneasler's Close Combat is the reliable answer to theirs. If they adapt next series, expect Raichu-Mega-Y over one of the TR pieces — Delphox-Mega already covers it.
reflections.notebook: Durable for a rematch: (1) Default shell is Staraptor + Farigiraf lead — Helping Hand into Staraptor early, Farigiraf Protects under pressure then sets Trick Room to enable Arcanine-H and Kingambit. (2) Armor Tail Farigiraf blocks all priority: never Fake Out or Sucker Punch while it is on the field. (3) Contrary Mega Staraptor: Intimidate only works pre-Mega (base ability Intimidate); post-Mega any drop becomes a boost and its Close Combat raises its Def/SpD — kill it fast with special damage; Psyshock OHKOes cleanly at +0 Def but is shaky once Contrary Def boosts stack. (4) Defiant Kingambit: never Intimidate or Parting Shot into it; Sneasler's Close Combat OHKOes (4x SE), Sneasler resists its Dark STABs and outspeeds it outside TR; both Kingambit sit at 71 Spe, so the Trick Room mirror is a speed tie — don't rely on winning it. (5) My Kingambit is immune to Farigiraf's Psychic and walls Arcanine-H — my best Trick Room abuser. (6) Delphox-Mega (204 Spe) outspeeds and Psyshock-KOs Raichu-Mega-Y, but Arcanine-H's Head Smash KOs it even at -2 Atk — never leave Delphox in on Arcanine. (7) Sneasler (189 Spe) outspeeds their whole roster outside Trick Room (fastest is Arcanine at 156) — ideal late-game cleaner once TR expires. (8) They left Raichu and Sylveon home in game 2, fully committing to the Trick Room shell; if they adjust, Raichu-Mega-Y (No Guard Zap Cannon) is the likely pivot, and Delphox-Mega remains the answer.
